app.name: HRSG Dashboard
app.tagline: HRSG performance diagnostics for better plant efficiency

mock.full: MOCK DATA — figures shown are unverified placeholder values

connection.offline: Cannot reach the backend. Check that the server is running on port 8000.

calc.title: Performance & Economics Calculator
calc.subtitle: Results recalculate as you change inputs. All figures are placeholder (mock) values.
calc.error: Could not load the calculation result ({{code}}).

input.title: Adjust inputs
input.reset: Reset to the selected model's design values (no loss)
input.advancedHint: Leave blank to exclude a value. Pinch and approach evaluation then shows 'Data needed'.
input.blocked: Recalculation paused because of invalid input. Results shown are from the last valid input.

trend.title: Loss sensitivity to pressure drop
trend.aria: Total loss versus pressure drop. At the current {{x}} mbar, total loss is {{y}} MW

cleaning.title: Cleaning method cost comparison
cleaning.caption: Cost is the total investment per method, net benefit is annual, and payback uses the monthly benefit. All figures are demo values.

ask.hint: Send the current result to the Ask screen to request an interpretation.

calc.restoreFailed: The previous calculation could not be found, so default values are shown.

tabs.label: Calculator view
tabs.loss: Current state / Expected loss / Cleaning recovery effect

schematic.title: HRSG schematic
schematic.displayOnly: Display only (not used in loss calculation)
schematic.hintHover: Hover over or press a component to see its display fouling and operating indicators.
schematic.hintTap: Tap a component to see its display fouling and operating indicators.

efficiency.title: Heat recovery efficiency trend
efficiency.subtitle: Monthly efficiency decline and recovery after cleaning
efficiency.aria: Heat recovery efficiency trend. Design {{design}}, current {{current}}, after cleaning {{after}}
efficiency.note: With no operating history, this estimate assumes a steady decline from the design value to the current value over {{months}} months.

advice.caution: Some indicators are outside the design range

warn.exhaustFlowOffRated: Exhaust gas flow differs from rated by more than 20%; results may be less reliable.
warn.exhaustTempAboveRated: Exhaust temperature is more than 30℃ above rated.

chat.subtitle: Ask HRSG technical questions and performance/economics calculations. Figures come only from calculator result cards.
chat.devMode: Development mode: AI answers are rule-based sample responses (Fake) and the sources are fictional sample documents. This changes once a real LLM and documents are connected.
chat.devModeDocs: Reference documents are fictional examples until real documents are added.
chat.calcContext: Answers are based on the result passed from the calculator.
chat.empty: Ask anything, or start with a suggested question below.

input.label: Your question
input.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line

suggestions.label: Suggested questions
suggestions.s1: How does HRSG fin fouling affect GT back pressure?
suggestions.s2: F-class GT, 35 mbar pressure drop, 110℃ stack — what is the annual loss?
suggestions.s4: How do I choose a cleaning method?
suggestions.cleaning: How much would cleaning recover under these conditions?

confirm.title: Please confirm the values needed for the calculation
confirm.hint: Required values missing from your question are proposed from model defaults. Confirm or edit them, then run the calculation.
confirm.editHint: Edit values and recalculate to add a new result card.

citations.title: Sources
citations.aiDetail: Not supported by the provided material; written by AI from general knowledge. It is not a literature source, so verify important points against original documents.

notice.blocked: This request can't be processed. Please ask an HRSG-related question.
notice.confidential: Internal formulas, coefficients and source documents can't be shared. Check figures in the calculator or the result card.
notice.outOfScope: I can answer questions about HRSG and combined-cycle performance.
notice.paramsNeeded: Please confirm a few values for an accurate calculation.
notice.invalidParams: Some values are out of range. Please check and recalculate.
notice.sanitized: Figures whose source couldn't be verified were removed. Refer to the result card for figures.

errors.LLM_NOT_CONFIGURED: AI is not configured. Check LLM_API_KEY in .env.
errors.LLM_AUTH_FAILED: The AI API key is invalid or lacks permission. Check LLM_API_KEY in .env.
errors.LLM_MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The configured AI model was not found. Check LLM_MODEL in .env.
errors.LLM_RATE_LIMITED: AI quota exceeded. The free tier limits daily requests per model. Try again later or enable billing.
errors.RAG_UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the paper search server. Check that the RAG search API (port 8100) is running.
errors.LLM_UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the AI service. Check your network and try again.
errors.INTERRUPTED: The connection was interrupted (e.g. page reload) before the answer arrived.

history.title: Chat history
history.clearConfirm: Delete all saved conversations? This cannot be undone.
history.localNote: Chat history is saved only in this browser. It won't appear on other devices or browsers.

checklist.subtitle: Check off the plant data needed for the performance review, then build and copy a request email.
checklist.loadError: Could not load the checklist. Check that the backend server is running.

reset.confirm: Clear all checks and notes and start over?

memo.label: Note for {{item}}
memo.placeholder: Note (e.g. department, DCS tag, expected reply date)

linked.tooltip: This data feeds the calculator's '{{field}}' input.
linked.kitOnly: Used by the calculation kit (this calculator screen has no field for it).

sync.failed: Could not save to the server. The change is kept in this browser for now.
sync.pending: {{count}} change(s) not yet saved to the server are kept in this browser.

email.title: Data request email
email.privacy: The email lists item names only, never notes or measured values. Plant and customer names are masked automatically.
email.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the preview text and copy it manually.
email.selectedHint: The text is selected. Press Ctrl+C (or long-press and copy on mobile).

errors.generic: The request could not be completed.

refs.title: Reference database
refs.titleHint: Enter the title exactly as printed on the first page. It is the first line of chatbot citations.

saved.reloaded: Saved and applied to the search server.
saved.unavailable: Saved. The search server is off; changes apply when it starts.
saved.rejected: Saved. Restart the search server to apply the changes.
saved.not_configured: Saved to the document JSON. RAG_CORPUS_ALL_PATH is not set, so rebuild the corpus to apply it to search.

refs.notConfigured: The reference folder is not configured.
refs.notConfiguredHint: The paper corpus is not public, so reference management runs locally only. Add these paths to the server .env and restart the backend.

issues.corpus_all_stale: {{field}} in corpus_all.json differs from the document JSON
issues.corpus_all_paragraphs_mismatch: Paragraphs in corpus_all.json differ from the document JSON ({{detail}}) — rebuild the corpus and index
